old_caption: The video depicts a close-up view of two hands manipulating an orange rubber band against a plain white background. The hands are positioned centrally in the frame, with one hand holding the rubber band at each end. The fingers are carefully pulling and stretching the rubber band, creating tension and elongating it. The background remains static throughout the sequence, providing a stark contrast to the vibrant orange color of the rubber band. In the upper left corner, there is a small, rectangular object that appears to be a piece of metal or a similar material, but it remains stationary and does not interact with the rubber band. The focus remains on the hands and the rubber band, emphasizing the action of stretching and manipulating the band. There are no other objects or characters present in the scene, and the camera maintains a steady position, ensuring that the viewer's attention is solely on the hands and the rubber band.

caption: The video depicts a close-up view over a plain white surface where two hands manipulate a thin, translucent orange elastic band. Two short wooden sticks rest in the background, one angled at the upper left and a smaller piece partly hidden behind the band. The band is held as a small loop pinched between the fingertips of both hands, the left thumb and index finger gripping one side while the right thumb and index finger grip the other. The right hand twists and works its end of the band while the left hand keeps the loop open, so a twisted, knotted section forms in the strand running to the right. As the right hand pulls its end outward, the horizontal strand lengthens and the twist becomes more pronounced, while the left index finger gradually withdraws. The loop then settles around the left thumb, which holds it open, and the right hand's fingertips keep the twisted strand stretched to the right. The configuration is held steady through the rest of the clip with only minor adjustments, the background sticks and white surface staying fixed.
